subject: maths
question: An article is sold for Rs. 5000 at a loss of 25 percent. What is the cost price of the article?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = Rs. 5000

Loss = 25%

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) = SP / (1 - (Loss% / 100))

**Calculation:**

Loss% = 25

SP = Rs. 5000

CP = SP / (1 - (Loss% / 100))

CP = 5000 / (1 - (25 / 100))

CP = 5000 / (1 - 0.25)

CP = 5000 / 0.75

CP = 6666.66

**The cost price of the article is Rs. 6666.66.**
